article.headline: Nique Clifford scores career-high 36 to lead Colorado State over Boise State 83-73
article.description: — Nique Clifford scored a career-high 36 points to lead Colorado State past Boise State 83-73 on Friday night in a Mountain West Conference regular-season finale.
article.linkText: Nique Clifford scores career-high 36 to lead Colorado State over Boise State 83-73

categories.description: Colorado State Rams @ Boise State Broncos

event.description: Colorado State Rams @ Boise State Broncos

keywords: Colorado State Rams @ Boise State Broncos
article.story: BOISE, Idaho -- — Nique Clifford scored a career-high 36 points to lead Colorado State past Boise State 83-73 on Friday night in a Mountain West Conference regular-season finale. Clifford shot 13 for 18 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line for the Rams (22-9, 16-4), who finished second to New Mexico in earning the No. 2 seed. Colorado State earns a bye into Thursday's quarterfinals. Kyan Evans added 14 points and Jalen Lake scored 11 as the Rams upped their win streak to seven. Andrew Meadow led the Broncos (22-9, 14-6) with 22 points and six rebounds. Alvaro Cardenas totaled 18 points, six rebounds and eight assists. Tyson Degenhart added 15 points and nine rebounds as the Broncos saw a five-game win streak end. Clifford had 13 points in the first half of a 34-all tie. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
